rule: All reusable Code Atlas source under src/code_atlas must be machine-neutral, repository-neutral and product-neutral. Product-specific behavior may exist only behind explicit profiles or named adapter boundaries and must never be selected implicitly.

adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/ui_bridge: Legacy product UI application bridge with product-specific binding contracts.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/tablet_map: Explicit tablet-surface compatibility adapter; a tablet surface is not a universal Code Atlas assumption.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/surface_target_atlas: Legacy product surface-target implementation with fixed product surface semantics; generic target discovery is profile-driven elsewhere.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/appbrain_batch_packager: Legacy tri-surface product batch packager; external projects provide their own app inventory through profiles.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/app_map/uimap: Product UI-component atlas compatibility implementation; default App Map uses the generic profile-driven runner.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/legal_readiness: Existing legal/investor-readiness orchestration is a product integration bound to product authority artifacts and external evidence adapters. It is not part of the neutral default execution path.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/operational/suite50.py: Legacy all-in-one operational compatibility suite with product-specific verifier discovery; neutral export/security helpers no longer depend on it.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/ui/motor_hub.py: Existing premium product Motor Hub retained for compatibility; default UI export uses generic_motor_hub.py.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/app_map/runner.py: Existing product App Map retained for compatibility; default App Map export and CLI use the generic profile-driven runner.
Legacy product runtime-probe readiness extension with fixed product visual rules and named external tooling; generic App Map does not import it.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/app_map/verify_target_rea: Verifier for the explicit legacy target-readiness adapter.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/app_map/verify_visual_dif: Verifier for the explicit product App Map safety-contract adapter.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/operational/verify_licsco: Verifier for the explicit licensing-scope compatibility adapter.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/evidence_ingestion/triad_: Legacy product evidence triad closer that writes product registers; never selected by neutral execution.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/motors/prisma_mesh_gatewa: Explicit product authority gateway that consumes neutral repository intelligence and composes product-specific authority requirements and legacy surface evidence.
adapterReasons.src/code_atlas/motors/prisma_mesh_revali: Explicit PRISMA Authority Mesh revalidation adapter. It consumes previously composed product authority evidence, evaluates task-bound relevant drift, and is reachable only through its named module/workflow entrypoint; neutral Code Atlas execution never selects it implicitly.

adapterSelectionRule: Explicit opt-in only through CODE_ATLAS_PROFILE/profile metadata, an adapter-specific entrypoint, or an explicitly selected adapter CLI command. Generic imports and entrypoints must not select an adapter implicitly.
forbiddenInNeutralPath: developer home paths on POSIX systems
